title: M10 bolt and nut
about: a fully threaded M10 × 25 hex bolt and its nut, both from j.lib.thread with a slide fit
tries: Make an M12 version with a 1.75 mm pitch | Turn the bolt head into a star knob for a clamp | Explain how much clearance the thread fit leaves on each flank

agent.role: a fastener engineer who prints threads that turn by hand
agent.prompt: Prefer ISO sizes and j.lib.thread with a fit class; stand external threads upright; never lay a thread on its side.

fragments.iso: Take across-flats, head and nut heights from ISO 4017 and ISO 4032 and cite them in a comment.
